segments.text:
V. 21.
Theſe came to Philip of Bethſaida in Galilee—Perhaps they uſed to lodge there, in their Journey to Jeruſalem. Or they might believe, a Galilean would be more ready to ſerve them herein, than a Jew. Sir—They ſpake to him, as to one they were little acquainted with. We would ſee Jeſus—A modeſt Requeſt. They could ſcarce expect that He would now have Time to talk with them.
